title: Corpse shade: can you tell rich meat from poor?
question: Six corpses, worth 120 / 320 / 520 / 760 / 1020, then a burnt one with no stamp. A corpse is now worth what the animal was made of, and its shade is the only player-visible sign of that. Which ramp reads? B changes nothing but the palette in corpse.ron (3 browns -> 5, span widened from 20 to 100 in red). Rendered at 10x; at play zoom the difference is smaller still.
context_md: S3 makes food carry its own value. The visible half is corpse shade. A is what ships today after I reordered the palette dark-to-light (it was non-monotone: a corpse worth 760 rendered DARKER than a starved one worth 120). A is correct now but I do not think it is legible - this is the same order of colour difference as the canopy-density sheet that read as blank. B is my proposed widening. Left-to-right the corpses go starved -> killed in its prime; the last one burnt to death and carries no stamp, so it should NOT read as the richest.
